title: WellbeingSignal
description: SAIA-Class S wellbeing signal representing a measurable indicator of wellbeing, stability, safety, or risk within Beast System 3.0.

signalId.description: Unique identifier for the wellbeing signal (UUID recommended).

caseId.description: ID of the wellbeing case this signal belongs to.

category.description: Signal category (emotional, environmental, safety, economic, relational, identity, digital, etc.).

type.description: Specific signal type (e.g., emotional-regulation, housing-stability, food-security, burnout-risk).

value.description: Numeric value of the signal (0–100 recommended).

trend.description: Trend direction of the signal over time.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the signal was recorded.

source.description: Origin of the signal (system, actor, wellbeing-engine, predictive-engine, manual-input).
